remarks: Discover turnkey Ellicottville living in this beautifully renovated, fully furnished luxury studio at Wildflower, ideally situated between Holiday Valley Resort and the Village of Ellicottville. Completely updated from top to bottom, this inviting ground-floor condo combines modern finishes, everyday convenience, and an established rental history, and you won't believe the storage in this studio unit. The stylish interior features a new kitchen and bathroom with custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, radiant-floor heat, hardwood floors throughout, air conditioning, an in-unit washer and dryer ( a rarity in studio units), a gas fireplace, and a Jacuzzi soaking tub. Enjoy peaceful pond views and the convenience of ground-floor living, with parking just steps from your door. Walk to the village or Holiday Valley and enjoy easy access to skiing, golf, hiking, biking, restaurants, shopping, and year-round recreation. Whether you're looking for a personal vacation getaway, a low-maintenance retreat or an income-producing investment, this property offers plenty of possibilities. The condo has an established rental history, with current monthly rental rates of approximately $1,750 from April through November and $2,000 from December through March, offering up to $22,000 in potential annual gross rental income at full occupancy. This condo is being offered fully furnished with just a few exclusions. Whether you are ready to enjoy personally or reap rental benefits, this is an excellent opportunity to own your own piece of Ellicottville's four-season resort lifestyle!
